suppress.notes: False positive in Jenkins: Dependency-Check reports both CVEs against httpcore5 5.5. CVE-2026-54399 affects httpcore5 5.4.2 and earlier, or 5.5-beta1 and earlier; the final 5.5 release is not affected. CVE-2026-54428 affects the separate httpcore5-h2 artifact, not httpcore5, and only those same older versions. This suppression applies only to httpcore5 5.5; it does not hide findings against httpcore5-h2 or other HttpComponents versions. Checked against the Apache advisories on 2026-11-20: https://lists.apache.org/thread/zmxh1pl2zohov5ntdh4lt85gfrlchgpy https://lists.apache.org/thread/5zjp8vczvxq19pw2rvhs21q446bhl0sd
